name: Micro & Nano Mechanics
summary: Mechanics and manufacturing at micrometre and nanometre scales, where scaling laws change which forces dominate: thin films, MEMS structures and nanoscale testing.

topics.name: Scaling laws in micro- and nanosystems
Mechanics of thin films: residual stress, Stoney equation, delamination
Micro-beams, plates and membranes; electrostatic actuation and pull-in
MEMS resonators, damping and quality factor
Microfabrication of mechanical structures (lithography, etching, micro-molding)
Size effects in plasticity and strength at small scales
